doc: Vowbound summons (SPEC 6.3, M2-CMB-04). Rules: docs/kb/design/battle_ctb.md section Vowbound; stats: formulas.md section Vowbound. A called Vowbound replaces the whole active party; the call is the caller's action at call_rank (1..8), which it pays once the party is back. Every stat is Formulas.vowbound_stat(base, the caller's stat, scale_pct) at the caller's level. skills are skills.json rows it knows (none may be a Swell technique); swell.rate fills its gauge from HP it loses and HP it gains by absorbing (ADR 0027 A1; Formulas.swell_gain over its own max HP); swell.technique is its finisher (a skills.json row with swell and vowbound true that nobody learns). Battle identity per vowbound: docs/kb/story/vowbound.md. bound_flag is the story flag (flags.tres) that binds it: a live battle lets the caller call it while the flag is set (M2-UI-05; the engine never reads flags).

vowbound._note: M3-C05-02 PROVISIONAL (Kahre, the Lightning Vowbound, bound in Ch5 B10; vowbound.md §2). Raw lightning that ignores defence and the real Last Strike are the combat request M3-C05-06. In no sim suite.

M3-CMB-01 PROVISIONAL (Virel, the Fire Vowbound, bound in Ch8 B06; vowbound.md §3): fast fire that delays foes on the timeline, and Flare Line, which lights the wall (clears storm_dark). Its full kit is a combat request. Banded in the undertows_reach suite.
M4-A2P-024 PROVISIONAL (plan/act2/bosses/nhoa.md): the Ice Vowbound, who copies the last enemy action, bound at ch11_nhoa_bound. Banded with the Act II boss suites once Asha calls them.
M4-A2P-024 PROVISIONAL (plan/act2/bosses/hesk.md): the Holy Vowbound, who cleanses and mends, bound at ch12_hesk_bound. Banded with the Act II boss suites once Asha calls them.
M4-A2P-024 PROVISIONAL (plan/act2/bosses/ethren.md): the Glimmer Vowbound, who slows, stops and wards, bound at ch13_ethren_bound. Banded with the Act II boss suites once Asha calls them.

M4-A2P-025 PROVISIONAL (plan/act2/bosses/kesh.md): the Glimmer Vowbound, bound in Ch16 C4 (ch16_kesh_bound), called from Act III. She cycles her six voices in the order the pilgrimage met them (BattleCycle): only this turn's voice may be used, and the timeline shows the next. Not used in an Act II fight; banded with her Act III suite.
